body: @Postremus do you have some profiling data for before/after? The problem is not immediately obvious even with the commit.

Flamegraphs of a quarkus:dev run:

[flamegrpahs.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/8405197/flamegrpahs.zip)


Search for "ArcProcessor\.generateResources".
2.7.5.Final: 1.54%
2.8.0.CR1: 4.42%

This is kind of expected. We need to wrap every construction of a _removed_ bean info with a `try-catch block` and in the reprodurer there is 82 removed beans. So the generated bytecode is more complex. From the flame graphs it seems that it's `MethodWriter#computeAllFrames()` and `Frame#merge()` that takes the most time. I'm not sure if we could do something about that? CC @stuartwdouglas @FroMage @geoand
FTR the reproducer seems to use quarkus 1.13.1.Final in the pom ;-)

So I've tried to split the bytecode that loads removed beans into larger number of smaller methods (previously 82 bens got split into 5 methods and now it's split into ~ 17 methods) and the problem with `MethodWriter#computeAllFrames()` and `Frame#merge()` seems to be gone. I'll send a draft PR so that @Postremus can verify my findings...

issue.title: ComponentsProviderGenerator - lower group limit for addRemovedBeans()
issue.body:
- to eliminate the perf regression caused by
MethodWriter#computeAllFrames() and Frame#merge()
- resolves #24712
